monitored_text: Home Newsroom Service Availability during the Annual Spring Festival Service Availability during the Annual Spring Festival Press Release Jan 27, 2026 Table of Contents Available Services During Spring Festival Holiday Order Placement Notes The Spring Festival (Lunar New Year) is approaching, and we are so grateful for your support over the past year. The Spring Festival holiday will span from February 10 to February 23 . JLC will continue to support your manufacturing needs during the Spring Festival holiday. We will provide the same high-quality manufacturing services for PCB, PCBA, 3D Printing, CNC machining, and mechatronic parts sourcing , and more . Below are the available services during the holiday, along with the production and shipping schedule. We recommend scheduling order placement in advance to help ensure timely project completion. Production & Shipping Schedule: Order Placement Schedule (For Reference): Available Services During Spring Festival Holiday CNC Machining All CNC machining materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for Steel 45# and SUS304 . Spray painting , mirror polishing , transparent polishing and blue-tinted transparent polishing services will be unavailable. Please note the following limitations during the holiday period: · The maximum supported part size is 500 × 500 × 200 mm . · Parts with highly complex structures requiring 5-axis machining are not supported. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. Sheet Metal Sheet Metal Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. PCB & PCBA Services Notes: Build times may be extended by around 2 days during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-Stencil Service SMT-stencil orders will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday. SMT-stencil build time: 3 days Parts Orders Types Production Availability JLCPCB In-stock Parts No impact on order processing. JLCPCB Pre-order Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Global Sourcing Parts Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from outside Mainland China) Unavailable from February 15 to February 23. Consigned Parts Service(ship from Mainland China) No impact on order processing. Flexible Heater Flexible Heater Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . PCB Layout PCB Layout Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24 . 3D Printing All 3D printing materials will remain in production during the Spring Festival holiday, except for the BJ-316L material. Note: Build times may be extended by 2–3 days during the Spring Festival holiday. JLCMC- Mechatronic Parts Service Types Shipping Availability In-stock Parts Can be shipped during the Spring Festival holiday, except February 16 to February 19. Back-orders Parts Service is unavailable from February 10 to February 23. Orders placed during the Spring Festival holiday will be processed starting from February 24. API Application (JLCAPI.com) The API applications submitted between February 10 and February 24 will be reviewed on February 24, 2026. Order Placement Notes 1. Orders scheduled for production from February 2 to February 23 cannot be combined with orders scheduled for production after the holiday. 2. During the Spring Festival holiday, the order combining rules are as follows: · PCB / PCBA / Stencil: Can be combined and shipped together, but cannot be combined with other product types. · 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Sheet Metal, Flexible Heater, Mechatronic Parts: Must be ordered separately. 3. Except for New User Coupons and after-sales compensation coupons, all other coupons will be temporarily unavailable during the Spring Festival holiday, and their validity periods will be extended accordingly. 4. JLC Balance Top-up and Withdrawal Schedule · Top-up: Suspended from February 17 to February 19 · Withdrawal: Suspended from February 10 to February 23 5.
